purpose: Teach: 六本木/しみじみ/芸人/クーラー/日焼け/コップ/数える/茶色

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、六本木、絶対、行ったことある?本気で
lines.en: Mom — have I actually ever been to Roppongi? Seriously?
lines.style: Urgent, stacked questions tumbling out. Small voice reaching upward. Sho needs a real answer, not dismissal. The repetition comes from genuine curiosity, not nervousness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママ、本気で、絶対、しみじみ、絶対、思うんだけど、翔くん、絶対、大きくなったわ
lines.en: Sho — you know, I really do think you've grown so much.
lines.style: Soft, almost to herself at first. Settles into warmth. The words come from noticing small things — his height, his seriousness. Gentle wonder, not sentimental.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんの、本気で、絶対、お気に入りの、絶対、芸人、絶対、テレビ、絶対、出てたよ
lines.en: Mom — Dad's favorite comedian was on TV and performed there.
lines.style: Animated, proud of the connection he's made. Bounces slightly on the discovery. Still earnest underneath — he wants Mom to see what he saw.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お部屋の、本気で、絶対、クーラー、絶対、強すぎないかしら
lines.en: Sho — isn't the air conditioning in your room too strong?
lines.style: Gentle redirect, soft interrogative lilt. Not worried-fussing, just noticing. Practical concern wrapped in tenderness. She's checking in on his comfort without making it a big thing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、海で、絶対、日焼け、絶対、しちゃった
lines.en: Mom — I actually got pretty badly sunburned at the beach.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact admission with a slight wry edge. Not complaining, just reporting a fact he's accepted. Small laugh underneath — he knows it's funny in retrospect.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、新しい、絶対、コップ、絶対、用意したわよ
lines.en: Sho — I got you a new cup — it's in the kitchen now.
lines.style: Warm, casual announcement. The kind of small thoughtfulness that doesn't demand acknowledgment but deserves it. Practical affection wrapped up small.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、お小遣い、絶対、数える、絶対、の、絶対、楽しいよ
lines.en: Mom — I really do enjoy counting my allowance, you know.
lines.style: Sincere delight, unguarded. The kind of simple pleasure a six-year-old says without irony. Soft smile in his voice — he's letting Mom in on something true.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの、本気で、絶対、茶色、絶対、のコート、絶対、お似合いね
lines.en: Sho — your father's brown coat really does suit you.
lines.style: Warm observation, intimate and close. No distance. The kind of thing she notices and comments on because she's looking at him fondly. Affectionate, present.
